source: World English Bible (public domain, ebible.org), with "Yahweh" shown as "the LORD" ("LORD" when God is addressed). Text otherwise unchanged; a leading "…" marks a verse that begins mid-sentence.
note: One verse per calendar day (MM-DD), including 02-29. 01-01, 12-24 and 12-25 are chosen for the date; the rest are spread through the year.
